name: Madeira
description: Run x86-64 Windows PC games on jailed iOS via FEX-Emu + Wine + DXMT
one_liner: Lets you play some Windows PC games on your iPhone without jailbreaking it, by translating the game's code on the fly.
buyer: Honestly, there isn't a real paying buyer here — this is a hobbyist research/emulation project, not a business.
business_use_cases: A retro/PC-gaming enthusiast community uses it to play a handful of supported titles on iPhones, purely for personal enjoyment.
A hobbyist developer contributes fixes to grow the list of playable games as a passion project.
An emulation YouTuber covers it for content, but there's no product here to sell.

money_ideas.idea: There isn't a legitimate one: it can't ship on the App Store (JIT/sideload only), sits in a legal gray area with game publishers, and upstream FEX-Emu explicitly forbids AI-assisted contributions — this is a community research project, not a business.

steal_this: There's nothing to 'steal' here commercially — this is a fun weekend project to run yourself, not a foundation to build a business on.
